experiment.description: Null primitives, primary scale, unbiased successor ordering. Pairs with c4 by seed. The honest 100-node analogue of the null baseline: no dynamics block, so the successor choice is live. This differs from exp_002_null, which pins revisability_rate 0.0 and never reaches the choice.

hypotheses.description: Exploratory-scale contrast. Per-seed ratio c1/c2 on total_state_transitions and on contested_claim_resolution_rate, paired by seed, summarised by median across the five seeds. Predicted to land in [1, 5]. Falsified if the median ratio is >= 10 on either metric. Not pooled: the ratio is formed within a seed before any aggregation.
hypotheses.note: Estimated quantity, not a predicted value. The declared prediction is the interval, evaluated on the paired median.

hypotheses.description: Exact reproduction under an unbiased ordering. c2 at seed 42 must reproduce exp_001's recorded metrics exactly; that is the only seed with a prior reference. c4 must give authority_concentration_gini = 49/675 on every seed. Falsified by any deviation beyond floating-point precision.
hypotheses.note: Full-governance runs are verified policy-invariant (INT-196 test b), so this is a control: it should hold regardless of ordering, and its failure would indicate the substream perturbs the main RNG stream.

hypotheses.description: Primary-scale contrast. Per-seed ratio c3/c4 on total_state_transitions, paired by seed, summarised by median. Predicted within one order of magnitude. Falsified if the median ratio falls outside [0.01, 100].
hypotheses.note: Estimated quantity, not a predicted value.

hypotheses.description: Determinism. Re-running any config in this batch reproduces its scorecard bit-identically. Falsifies independently of H1-H3 and invalidates the batch if it fails.
